body: EVENT-SEGMENTATION VISUALIZATION DISPOSITION (source discussion: storymodel4s topic event-segmentation-topic-modeling, chief decision post-01M16S5E78D6KEA53DYET07PH3). StoryAtlas must show two synchronized but non-substitutable objects: a task-conditioned perceptual-boundary evidence track with declared instruction/grain, and the resolved narrative hierarchy as brackets/regions. It must never render the hierarchy as though it were human event-segmentation gold, nor silently turn repeated provider/config LLM calls into independent-rater consensus. No StoryAtlas implementation bead follows yet: storymodel4s first needs the Int-level ADR and a frozen named multi-story decision spike. This is a durable design constraint, not a current code dependency.
